evidence.observation: Growth began at 2.938 Torr, the same as the ramp baseline of about 2.94 Torr at 100 sccm Ar.
Pressure has risen steadily to 3.208 Torr (about +9%) over 720 s, and the rise is speeding up.
Argon flow is steady at about 100 sccm, so more gas in does not explain the pressure rise.
Temperature is steady at 750 °C and heater power at about 45%, so the thermal side looks normal.
No exhaust O2 sensor is installed, so I can't use it to tell an air leak from an exhaust restriction.

args.missing_evidence: Something that tells a seal leak from an exhaust blockage. Options: an exhaust O2 or residual-gas reading; a rate-of-rise test with the Ar flow shut off (pressure climbing with no flow points to a leak); or checking pump and exhaust-line conductance or trap loading.
